data.name: WarnUploadMessage
data.value:
VAROVÁNÍ - nahrávání každé QSO do on-line lodního deníku, jak je přihlášen může mít nezamýšlené vedlejší účinky, pokud později změnit nebo smazat, že QSO.
DXKeeper Odesílání QSO jakmile je to zaznamenáno. Pokud QSO je později editován nebo smazán, brána jej odstraňuje z DXKeeper a zaznamenává opravený - ale nahrávání, které již vyšlo ven nelze odvolat. LoTW zejména nemá žádný způsob, jak odstranit QSO jste nahráli, takže původní zůstane tam a oprava je přidána vedle něj.
Zvažte nechat tyto vypnuté během soutěže a nahrávání z DXKeeper Ty sám, až bude záznam hotový.
Viz Nápověda, pod změnou / smazat QSOs a nahrávání přepínání.
data.comment:
EN: WARNING - uploading each QSO to an online logbook as it is logged can have unintended side effects if you later change or delete that QSO.
DXKeeper uploads a QSO as soon as it is logged. If the QSO is edited or deleted afterwards, the gateway removes it from DXKeeper and logs the corrected one - but an upload that has already gone out cannot be recalled. LoTW in particular has no way to delete a QSO you have uploaded, so the original stays there and the correction is added alongside it.
Consider leaving these switched off during a contest and uploading from DXKeeper yourself once the log is final.
See Help, under Change/Delete QSOs and Upload toggles. NOTE: The whole point of this string. "LoTW", "DXKeeper", "QSO" and the Help section name stay in English. Written without brackets on purpose - see the note on brackets at the top of this file.

data.comment: EN: Open the undelivered QSO file NOTE: Menu entry that opens FailedQSOs_*.adi.

data.name: TrayOpenFailedFolder
data.comment: EN: Show it in its folder NOTE: Menu entry that opens Explorer with the undelivered-QSO file selected. Needed as well as the entry above because .adi often has no program associated with it, and because the file may not be in the Gateway's own folder.

data.name: TrayFailureTitle
data.comment: EN: QSO not delivered NOTE: Title of the notification raised when DXKeeper does not confirm a QSO while the window is hidden.

data.name: TrayFailureMessage
data.value: DXKeeper není potvrzeno {0} QSOs Tohle sezení. Jsou uloženy pro vás import ručně.
data.comment: EN: DXKeeper has not confirmed {0} QSOs this session. They are saved for you to import by hand. NOTE: {0} is a count. Raised while the window is hidden, because the operator cannot see the warning bar then.

data.name: TrayTooltip
data.comment: EN: Received {0}, logged {1}, not delivered {2} NOTE: Tooltip under the product name. Windows caps the whole tooltip at 127 characters and it is truncated past that, so keep this short.

data.name: DxKeeperConfigNetworkService
data.comment: EN: Config > Defaults tab > Network Service NOTE: DO NOT TRANSLATE. A literal menu path inside DXKeeper, whose interface is English-only. NOT TRANSLATED: left in English deliberately - either a do-not-translate entry, or the machine pass damaged it and was rejected.
